LanguageData.LP_PactSigner.label: pact
LanguageData.LP_PactSigner.description: A pact signed with an otherworldly patron. In brackets are the patron and debt (0-3). Debt 1: mood -6, abilities granted by boons have cooldown ×2; debt 2: the patron sends debt collectors (Nine Hells) or the wild hunt (fey), then once every 15 days; debt 3: enforcement: the signer is dragged into that plane (lich: the phylactery is taken). "Compensate the patron" at the pact lectern pays off debt.
LanguageData.LP_PactSigner.stages.0.label: in good standing
LanguageData.LP_PactSigner.stages.1.label: in debt
LanguageData.LP_PactSigner.stages.2.label: pursued for debt
LanguageData.LP_PactSigner.stages.3.label: enforcement
LanguageData.LP_PactBound.label: pact guard
LanguageData.LP_PactBound.description: A guard the patron lends the signer under the pact: keeps the pact, obedience never drops. It goes back when the pact ends.
LanguageData.LP_PatronAgent.label: patron's agent
LanguageData.LP_PatronAgent.description: (Hidden) Leader of debt collectors / the wild hunt: drops the true name scroll of the patron's agent when downed.
LanguageData.LP_Boon_InfernalMark.label: mark of the Lord of Hell
LanguageData.LP_Boon_InfernalMark.description: The mark of Asmodeus burns on the forehead: hostile humanlikes within 5 cells are filled with fear (mental break threshold +15%); eldritch blast ignite chance 40%.
LanguageData.LP_InfernalDread.label: dread of the Nine Hells
LanguageData.LP_InfernalDread.description: The mark of the Lord of Hell is suffocating: mental break threshold +15%.
LanguageData.LP_Boon_IceArcana.label: arcana of the frozen hell
LanguageData.LP_Boon_IceArcana.description: Mephistopheles's ice flows in the veins: max neural heat +20%; frost damage hits add +1 extra stack of chilled to the bone.
LanguageData.LP_Boon_IronArtisan.label: iron city artisan
LanguageData.LP_Boon_IronArtisan.description: Dispater's pact: colony construction speed +25% (while the signer is alive and on this map).
LanguageData.LP_Boon_QueenTongue.label: the queen's tongue
LanguageData.LP_Boon_QueenTongue.description: The tongue Glasya lends the signer: social impact +30%, trade prices improved +15%.
LanguageData.LP_Boon_FrostShadow.label: frost shadow
LanguageData.LP_Boon_FrostShadow.description: The frost shadow of the Queen of Air and Darkness: turns invisible after standing still for 3 seconds, revealed by moving or attacking.
LanguageData.LP_Clause_Hellfire.label: hellfire
LanguageData.LP_Clause_Hellfire.description: The "hellfire" in the pact: fire damage taken ×1.25.
LanguageData.LP_Clause_IceHeart.label: frozen heart
LanguageData.LP_Clause_IceHeart.description: The "frozen heart" in the pact: mood always -5.
LanguageData.LP_Clause_WinterKiss.label: winter's kiss
LanguageData.LP_Clause_WinterKiss.description: The "winter's kiss" in the pact: min comfortable temperature +10°C.
LanguageData.LP_HellsClaim.label: the Nine Hells' claim
LanguageData.LP_HellsClaim.description: Firstborn clause: when this child turns eighteen, the Nine Hells will come to collect (50%).
LanguageData.LP_NameStolenHediff.label: lost name
LanguageData.LP_NameStolenHediff.description: The original name was taken by the patron, and the new name never feels right: social impact -20%.
